context: Tests whether the agent automates a documented test case (TC-001) as a single Playwright end-to-end test using Drama Finder: one test method walking all Flow steps in order across two views, the test case's Validation section asserted at the end, traceability to the TC/UC ids, and idempotent cleanup — as opposed to per-use-case integration tests split into independent test methods.

checklist.name: Extends AbstractBasePlaywrightIT
checklist.description: The test class extends AbstractBasePlaywrightIT from the Drama Finder library (org.vaadin.addons.dramafinder.AbstractBasePlaywrightIT), not any other base class

checklist.name: @SpringBootTest RANDOM_PORT
checklist.description: The test class is annotated with @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT) and injects the port via @LocalServerPort

checklist.name: Single test method for the whole flow
checklist.description: The complete test case flow (create order, verify listed, ship order, verify shipment) is executed inside ONE @Test method — NOT split into multiple @Test methods that depend on each other's state or on execution order

checklist.name: Step methods traceable to Flow rows
checklist.description: Each Flow table row is implemented as its own private step method (or clearly delimited step block with a comment naming the step), called in the same order as the test case's Flow table

checklist.name: Test case ID in @DisplayName
checklist.description: The @Test or class-level @DisplayName references the test case ID TC-001 and its goal for traceability

checklist.name: getView returns first Flow step route
checklist.description: getView() returns the route of the first Flow step's view ("orders"), and getUrl() returns http://localhost:<port>/

checklist.name: Navigates to the second view mid-flow
checklist.description: The shipping step navigates from the Orders view to the Shipping view (route "shipping") during the flow — via in-app navigation or page.navigate(getUrl() + "shipping")

checklist.name: Test Data values used verbatim
checklist.description: The step methods use the literal values from the test case's Test Data column: customer "Acme Corp", product "Widget", quantity 5

checklist.name: Validation section asserted
checklist.description: Both Validation entries are asserted: the orders grid count increased by exactly one (captured before vs after, using getTotalRowCount()), and the created order's status is "Shipped" in the orders grid

checklist.name: No raw page.locator() calls
checklist.description: The test file contains NO calls to page.locator(...) and no XPath — Drama Finder element wrappers (GridElement, ButtonElement, ComboBoxElement, DialogElement, NotificationElement, etc.) are used exclusively

checklist.name: No Thread.sleep / waitForTimeout
checklist.description: The test file contains NO calls to Thread.sleep() or page.waitForTimeout() — auto-retrying Drama Finder assertions are used instead

checklist.name: Scoped lookups inside dialogs
checklist.description: Element lookups inside the "New Order" and "Confirm Shipment" dialogs are scoped by passing dialog.getLocator() (not page) to the element factory methods

checklist.name: Idempotent cleanup of test-created data only
checklist.description: An @AfterEach method removes the order created by the test case (and only that data), and is written to tolerate a test that failed midway (checks existence before deleting; does NOT wipe all data)
